summary: Reads four DWORD fields of the object and writes them through caller-supplied output pointers. a2 receives this[26] (offset 0x68), a3 receives this[25] (offset 0x64), a4 receives this[21] (offset 0x54) and a5 receives this[22] (offset 0x58); every output pointer is individually null-guarded, and the function returns the a5 output pointer.

local_names.a5: output pointer for field this[22] (offset 0x58); also the return value

operations.description: Guard the a2 output pointer: when a2 is non-null, write this[26] (field this + 0x68) into *a2; otherwise skip.
Guard the a3 output pointer: when a3 is non-null, write this[25] (field this + 0x64) into *a3; otherwise skip.
Guard the a4 output pointer: when a4 is non-null, write this[21] (field this + 0x54) into *a4; otherwise skip.
Guard the a5 output pointer: when a5 is non-null, write this[22] (field this + 0x58) into *a5; otherwise skip.

unresolved: The viewport-dimension interpretation of the four fields (this+0x54 width, this+0x58 height, this+0x64/0x68 aliases) comes from the existing analysis fill at DERIVED trust and is not independently evidenced, so it is not adopted.
The semantic role of the object and of fields this[21], this[22], this[25], this[26] is not established by the packet.
The callers 0x004DC960, 0x00554B20 and 0x0055C070 are not resolved to a shared context, so the owner type remains unknown.
